operations.name: Extract a model brief from text and dimensions
prerequisites: Identify each value as supplied, measured, inferred, assumed, or calculated.
Declare units, origin, axes, component boundaries, intended output and source links.
changes_or_infers: Groups explicit requirements into named parameters and geometry constraints.
Does not infer hidden geometry from prose alone.
checks: Every numerical parameter has units and provenance.
Ambiguities affecting geometry are listed separately.
alternatives: Direct interactive OCS modeling after brief readback
Code-CAD generation from a validated brief
operations.summary: Create a source-linked brief before changing geometry; keep source claims separate from constraints and design choices.

operations.name: Rectify a raster drawing plane from known dimensions
prerequisites: For scale, provide known dimensions on the same plane.
A planar homography rectifies that plane and does not recover object depth.
changes_or_infers: Calculates a plane transform and metric image coordinates from matched points.
checks: Check independent in-plane lengths after rectification.
Record controls, units and transformation.
alternatives: Manual scale using a known dimension on a front-parallel scan
operations.summary: Rectify a single drawing plane using matched control coordinates; this route does not calibrate a general 3D camera or infer depth.

operations.name: Recognize dimension text with OCR
prerequisites: Retain original pixels and page transform.
Use OCR output as candidates; resolve glyphs, units, tolerance symbols and feature association against the source image.
changes_or_infers: Produces candidate text strings and numeric dimension values from pixels.
checks: Verify every dimension against the source crop.
Check decimal separator, diameter/radius symbols, tolerance, units and view association.
alternatives: Manual dimension transcription
Vector drawing dimension records when available
operations.summary: Tesseract TSV can return text and word bounding boxes with confidence; engineering interpretation and dimension association remain review steps.

operations.name: Extract raster edges, lines and contours
prerequisites: Rectify or record the image transform before measuring extracted pixels.
Separate dimension lines, extension lines, text and object contours by layers or masks.
preserves: Pixel coordinates and candidate segment endpoints
changes_or_infers: Approximates raster strokes as candidate vectors; line/contour algorithms do not classify engineering intent by themselves.
checks: Overlay candidates on source raster.
Measure endpoint gaps and edge displacement in calibrated coordinates.
Retain uncertain or intersecting candidates for review.
alternatives: Manual trace in OCS or FreeCAD
Learned wall/opening segmentation followed by vectorization
operations.summary: Image-processing primitives and floor-plan reconstruction research support candidate line extraction, while symbol and feature meaning require separate interpretation.

operations.name: Convert raster floor-plan candidates into a wall and opening graph
tools: floor-plan segmentation/vectorization model or manual trace
prerequisites: Establish plan scale and origin from a known control or explicit drawing dimensions.
Define wall centerline/edge convention and distinguish walls, openings, room labels and annotation.
changes_or_infers: Classifies walls/openings/rooms and infers graph connections from image patterns.
checks: Room/wall graph connectivity
Opening endpoints attach to wall segments
Known lengths and orthogonality
Manual confirmation of ambiguous symbols
alternatives: Trace wall centerlines and openings manually
Use a learned detector to propose vector geometry
operations.summary: Research papers demonstrate floor-plan segmentation, vectorization and structural graph reconstruction; exact measurements and semantics still need source-linked confirmation.

operations.name: Register orthographic drawing views in a shared coordinate frame
prerequisites: The vector drawing contains multiple identified orthographic views.
Identify front/top/side and first-angle/third-angle layout.
Identify view scales and shared datum from geometry or annotations.
Keep each source view 2D axes and projection direction.
Treat the input vector-drawing as a bundle containing at least two identified orthographic views, not as a single view.
changes_or_infers: Maps 2D view coordinates into common 3D projection coordinates and proposes corresponding edges.
checks: Projected edge coordinates agree across views within source resolution/tolerance.
Control dimensions agree across views.
Flag multiple possible correspondences.
alternatives: Manual view alignment in OCS/FreeCAD
Orthographic line-matching reconstruction research methods
operations.summary: Published methods establish coordinate-transform and cross-view matching routes; a learned reconstruction must still be checked against the actual drawing dimensions.

operations.name: Reconstruct a candidate 3D wireframe and surface from orthographic views
prerequisites: Register views and scale before matching.
Resolve edge and face ambiguity using dimensions, section views or author input.
Mark inferred surfaces and hidden features.
preserves: Input views and cross-view correspondence graph
changes_or_infers: Creates candidate 3D edges, faces and a watertight solid; hidden surfaces are inferred from the view set and method.
checks: Project generated model into each input view and compare edge residuals.
Check manifold/solid validity, dimensions and feature count.
Compare native feature history separately from imported shape.
alternatives: Human-in-the-loop FreeCAD feature reconstruction
Construct a CSG feature program from confirmed views
operations.summary: Proposed composition of published orthographic reconstruction methods and a CAD kernel: candidate edges/faces may be inferred from multiple views. This research does not document a deployable open reconstruction application.

operations.name: Read and clean vector drawing geometry
prerequisites: Preserve source file and hash.
Determine drawing units, model/paper space, layer selection, block transforms, origin and target sketch plane.
Read DXF/SVG import option and unsupported entity behavior.
preserves: Entity types, layers, blocks, annotations and source coordinates where supported
changes_or_infers: Selects profile entities, normalizes transforms and may join, discretize, or repair curves.
checks: Count input/output entities by type and layer.
Find duplicate/open/self-intersecting edges.
Compare profile bounds, area and source dimensions.
For SVG, verify viewBox and physical scale; FreeCAD importer flattens Z.
alternatives: Use the source DXF unchanged in OCS
Use FreeCAD native DXF or legacy importer
Parse DXF with ezdxf and build clean geometry separately
operations.summary: FreeCAD documents DXF/SVG entity coverage and import modes; ezdxf reads and writes DXF. Entity preservation and scale depend on the specific importer/settings.

operations.name: Build and constrain an editable planar sketch
tools: OpenCADStudio sketch/constraint capability as discovered in session
prerequisites: Specify units, support plane and datum.
Resolve profile closure/repair and record which source curves changed.
Associate each dimensional constraint with measured/source/inferred status.
preserves: Constraint provenance in the project evidence ledger
changes_or_infers: Adds constraints and may alter underconstrained geometry to satisfy them.
checks: Solver state/degrees of freedom
Residuals and overconstraints
Source-to-constraint numeric comparison
Profile closedness and intersections
alternatives: Keep vector geometry as non-parametric Draft/OCS drawing entities
Generate sketch geometry from code-CAD source
operations.summary: FreeCAD documents Python creation of Sketcher geometry and constraints. Solver success tests consistency, not the truth of supplied or inferred measurements.

operations.name: Create a kernel solid and native model document from confirmed parameters
prerequisites: Declare units, feature parameters, direction/axis and part boundary.
Use exact B-rep backend if exact surfaces/export are required.
Preserve native feature document or code source.
preserves: Native feature tree or executable parametric source
Editable native model document; feature history depends on the selected CAD application
changes_or_infers: Creates exact kernel geometry from the confirmed profile/feature instructions; unsupported features may require alternatives.
checks: Kernel shape validity and solid count
Bounds, volume, hole/shaft dimensions and units
Recompute or regenerate after one parameter change
Save/reopen and independent import
alternatives: FreeCAD feature-history model
build123d/CadQuery Python source
OCS native body; separate exact STEP exporter if needed
operations.summary: Build kernel CAD solids from a confirmed constrained sketch, parametric source, or explicit model brief plus dimensions. FreeCAD/build123d/CadQuery provide documented B-rep routes; OCS creates native geometry but its inspected STEP writer emits mesh-derived faceted STEP.

operations.name: Fit analytic features to scans or image-derived point clouds
prerequisites: Input is already a metric, registered point cloud, depth sequence, or mesh with a declared coordinate frame.
Identify functional interfaces and label unsampled/occluded surfaces.
Keep fit residuals and input samples with each analytic feature.
changes_or_infers: Fits planes, cylinders, axes or freeform surfaces from noisy samples; fits are calculated approximations.
checks: Independent control distances
Registration and reprojection residuals
Fit residual distribution/outlier mask
Held-out cloud-to-CAD distances
Interface dimensions
alternatives: Manual measurements from calibrated views
Use mesh as visual/collision reference without analytic remodeling
operations.summary: Fit analytic planes, cylinders and axes to an already calibrated/registered metric point cloud, depth sequence or mesh, retaining residuals and uncertain regions. Photograph-to-cloud reconstruction is a separate upstream operation.

operations.name: Assemble existing CAD or source-library components
prerequisites: Record component source/license/hash and representation.
Establish local units, origin, axis directions and interface frames for each part.
Separate source components from placeholders.
Provide a distinct base cad-solid plus either a source-library component or one or more additional cad-solid component files; identify each occurrence separately.
changes_or_infers: Places parts using declared mating frames; inferred contact or fastener geometry is proposal unless sourced.
checks: Frame/transform consistency
Interface dimension agreement
Component counts and source hashes
Collision/clearance only with supported exact geometry and query
alternatives: Visual-only assembly in Blender
OCS block/group drawing arrangement
Full parametric assembly in FreeCAD or Python code-CAD
operations.summary: Build an assembly from identified components and explicit transforms; preserve the difference between imported component geometry and inferred placeholders.

operations.name: Verify model geometry and saved output
prerequisites: Know the expected geometry representation and destination units.
Tie checks to the exact document revision and output file hash.
Set a check tolerance from source accuracy or explicit engineering requirement.
A fabrication-package is an input artifact to inspect, not an output created by verification.
preserves: Measured check results and failed checks
changes_or_infers: Reads or reopens derivatives and calculates verification measurements; does not repair by itself.
checks: Bounds, solid count, face types, volume and key dimensions
Entity/semantic manifest and save audit
Reopen in independent application
Feature history versus geometry-only transfer
Persist operation IDs, artifact revision/hash, units, result values and failed checks in verification-report.
Persist operation IDs, artifact revision/hash, units, result values and failed checks in verification-report.
alternatives: Visual review as a supplement
Application-native save audit
Separate neutral-file round-trip
operations.summary: Read back the saved artifact, run applicable checks, and persist measured bounds/dimensions plus artifact identity and failed checks for downstream diagnosis.

operations.name: Recover from failed interpretation or geometry construction
prerequisites: Preserve previous revision and source geometry.
Include a verification report identifying failed transition and affected artifact.
preserves: Failed output and logs for diagnosis
changes_or_infers: Returns to the earliest invalid interpretation or failed feature, then revises only that transition.
checks: Confirm operation completion/status
Read back geometry after each small change
Do not replay timed-out mutations without querying the same operation identity
Verify repaired dimensions and topology before downstream steps
alternatives: Ask for missing reference information
Keep vector source and defer solid construction
Select a different documented backend
operations.summary: Recover at the failing representation boundary, preserve the source and previous result, and rerun only downstream steps affected by the correction.

operations.name: Calibrate camera poses from photographs and known controls
prerequisites: Use views of known calibration geometry or identified known 3D points.
Declare physical target dimensions and units.
changes_or_infers: Estimates camera intrinsics, distortion, poses and reprojection residuals.
checks: Reprojection residuals
Independent control lengths
Camera model and image resolution consistency
alternatives: Calibrate each camera with a target
Use documented photogrammetry camera-solution pipeline
operations.summary: Estimate camera parameters and poses from known point correspondences; the OpenCV tutorial specifies real control dimensions to obtain metric scale.

operations.name: Render source-defined CSG as a mesh
prerequisites: Provide parametric-source in OpenSCAD syntax and resolve required parameters.
Choose a mesh export format and units; retain the source file as the editable parametric record.
preserves: OpenSCAD source and its parameterized CSG construction
changes_or_infers: Tessellates the evaluated CSG surface into mesh facets; the resulting mesh does not carry editable B-rep feature history.
checks: Regenerate after changing one source parameter.
Check mesh watertightness, normals, bounds, units and dimensional deviation against the source parameters.
alternatives: Use FreeCAD/build123d/CadQuery for a B-rep output requirement.
operations.summary: OpenSCAD documents source-defined constructive solid geometry and mesh export. This operation guarantees mesh output, not a CAD B-rep.

operations.name: Reconstruct camera poses and dense visible geometry from overlapping photos
prerequisites: Provide overlapping, sharp views of a rigid scene and measured scale/control data.
Inspect image-registration coverage, camera solution and dense-stage output; each output is a reconstruction result, not a direct measurement of hidden surfaces.
preserves: Estimated camera poses and control-point associations
changes_or_infers: Estimates camera poses and visible 3D samples/surfaces from image correspondences; unobserved surfaces and metric values outside control data remain inferred.
Sparse reconstruction scale is fixed from supplied measurement-set controls; local surface detail between/behind views remains estimated or absent.
checks: Review registered-view coverage, reprojection errors and camera poses.
Check control-point residuals and independent withheld dimensions.
Inspect cloud/mesh for holes, duplicate surfaces and outliers; record scale and frame transforms.
alternatives: RGB-D/LiDAR point-cloud acquisition
Manual photogrammetry review and reconstruction
operations.summary: Existing reconstruction research documents COLMAP and Meshroom photo-to-cloud/mesh paths and their quality gates. This operation is a proposed composition from those documented tools; no local runtime was exercised.

operations.name: Build wall and opening solids from a confirmed floor-plan graph
tools: FreeCAD Part/Sketcher or OCS native geometry
prerequisites: vector-drawing contains the reviewed plan wall/opening graph from CAD-05.
measurement-set contains known in-plane controls; model-brief contains confirmed wall height, thickness convention, opening dimensions/heights, floor datum and units.
Represent unknown elevations or wall build-ups as explicit parameters and do not fill them from plan pixels.
preserves: Confirmed plan dimensions and model-brief parameter provenance
changes_or_infers: Extrudes confirmed plan graph into separate candidate wall/opening solids and groups them as a CAD assembly.
Does not assign IFC classifications or unobserved construction layers.
checks: Check every generated opening attaches to its intended wall segment.
Check room graph/connectivity, wall lengths/thicknesses, opening positions and elevations.
Verify generated top/plan projections against the source plan and compare all known controls.
alternatives: Manual wall/opening construction from the reviewed graph in OCS or FreeCAD.
operations.summary: Compose a confirmed plan graph and explicit elevation/opening parameters into separate CAD wall/opening solids. Floor-plan papers describe research recognition/reconstruction methods; this operation proposes an editable CAD handoff and does not claim BIM/IFC semantics.

recipes.name: Text and explicit dimensions to an editable engineering part
recipes.goal: Create source-linked parametric geometry with a saved native model.
handoffs: Every model value has declared units and evidence status.
CAD-10 builds from the model brief and dimensions.
Choose OCS for the established project session; choose FreeCAD/code-CAD when constrained feature history or analytic B-rep exchange is required.
The original brief remains linked to each controlling dimension.
recipes.summary: Brief → evidence ledger → constrained sketch/parameters → CAD features → independent readback and export check.

recipes.name: Raster sketch plus measured scale to a constrained part
recipes.goal: Convert an image sketch into a constrained 2D profile and solid with traceable dimensions.
handoffs: Known lengths define image scale; image-only proportions remain inferred.
OCR text and curve candidates are reviewed against source pixels.
CAD-01 builds the brief from recovered text and explicit dimensions.
Profile extraction is checked against the original image overlay.
recipes.summary: Scale controls + OCR/vector candidates + human reconciliation + constrained profile + solid checks.

recipes.name: Raster floor plan plus dimensions to a 3D building hypothesis
recipes.goal: Produce editable wall/opening geometry with explicit scale and uncertain vertical dimensions.
handoffs: CAD-02 produces metric in-plane controls; CAD-03 produces text candidates; human review associates them to the geometry.
CAD-05 produces the reviewed wall/opening graph in vector-drawing.
CAD-17 requires confirmed height/opening/elevation values in the model brief; raster plan data does not supply missing vertical dimensions.
CAD-13 verifies walls, openings, dimensions, graph connections and saved artifact identity.
recipes.summary: Rectify and interpret the plan, review dimension OCR and wall/opening graph, then create separate candidate wall/opening solids from confirmed heights, thicknesses and elevations. The output is a CAD assembly, not an IFC model.

recipes.name: DXF or SVG drawing to a parametric solid
recipes.goal: Retain drawing evidence and construct a checked solid from a confirmed profile or feature layout.
handoffs: Original drawing file and hash remain unchanged.
Units, layer/filter, plane and transformations are stated.
CAD-09 requires vector geometry plus a model brief, dimensions or measurement-set.
Use exact-solid exporter when analytic exchange is required; OCS current STEP route is faceted.
recipes.summary: Preserve source drawing → choose profiles → clean/constraint → feature generation → exact representation check.

recipes.name: Registered orthographic vector views + dimensions → candidate parametric part
recipes.goal: Construct a model that projects consistently into every supplied view.
handoffs: Projection standard and view axes are identified.
CAD-06 receives one vector drawing that contains all identified orthographic views.
Edge and vertex matches are checked across views.
CAD-01/06 retain ambiguity and dimensions in the brief.
Generated model views are compared with original views.
recipes.summary: The vector-drawing input contains several identified orthographic views; measurement-set supplies drawing dimensions/controls and model-brief records projection convention and confirmed feature intent. Reconstruct and compare a candidate against all views.

recipes.name: Photographs, one measured length and a library candidate to an assembly
recipes.goal: Combine measured scan geometry and identified library components while keeping uncertain body geometry labeled.
handoffs: CAD-16 uses the photo set and measured control length to solve camera poses/scale and produce visible point-cloud/mesh outputs.
CAD-11 receives the reconstructed point cloud or mesh with measurement controls; it fits analytic interfaces and retains residuals.
CAD-12 combines the fitted scan geometry with identified library parts as separate components.
Unsampled/occluded surfaces remain inferred; do not warp library geometry silently.
recipes.summary: Reconstruct a scaled camera solution and visible point cloud/mesh from overlapping photos; fit analytic interface features; compare to a library component; assemble and verify. Photograph-derived hidden surfaces remain inferred.

recipes.name: Depth scan and existing housing CAD to a revised interface assembly
recipes.goal: Remodel one scoped interface from scan data while preserving the existing CAD housing.
handoffs: CAD-11 receives depth frames, a metric measurement set and returns one fitted component solid.
CAD-12 combines the fitted solid and existing housing solid.
Keep original housing file unchanged and record its hash.
Fit residuals and interface dimensions are checked independently.
recipes.summary: Align measured scan to retained CAD → fit interface primitives → remodel only the scoped component → check assembly interfaces. CAD-12 receives the retained housing and the distinct fitted component as separate cad-solid occurrences.

recipes.name: Library assembly with an unresolved component envelope
recipes.goal: Place identified source parts and isolate a placeholder for an unmodeled part.
handoffs: Source components retain their native identity and transform.
Placeholder geometry is labeled and has a declared basis.
No unobserved interface or part number is invented.
recipes.summary: Assemble known components by interface frames and leave the unresolved envelope visibly attributable to its current evidence status. CAD-12 receives the CAD solid as base and the library component as a separate part.

recipes.name: Orthographic line research route → candidate solid and verification
recipes.goal: Generate and verify candidate 3D geometry from registered views while retaining the algorithmic reconstruction as inferred geometry.
handoffs: CAD-06 output retains view correspondences and reconstruction assumptions in the brief.
CAD-07 is a documented research method/composition, not a verified deployable backend in this repository.
If editable feature history is needed, reconstruct a constrained feature model separately from the verified candidate solid.
recipes.summary: A proposed research-method route using orthographic line correspondence and learned shape-program papers to propose candidate geometry; the paper methods are not asserted to be an installed or validated runtime.

recipes.name: OpenSCAD CSG source → mesh derivative
recipes.goal: Generate and validate a mesh derivative while retaining editable OpenSCAD source.
handoffs: CAD-13 verifies mesh identity, bounds, units, watertightness and saved-file readback; the mesh remains distinct from a CAD solid.
recipes.summary: Render source-defined CSG to a mesh, preserve the source, then record mesh checks in a verification report.

ideas.name: Feature-level evidence ledger
ideas.summary: Link every model parameter and geometric feature to a source document, coordinate range, evidence status, units, transformation and uncertainty; keep solver constraints separate from measured inputs.
ideas.next_check: Prototype a JSON schema that points from model parameter IDs to image/DXF entities and measured-value status.

ideas.name: Two-channel raster interpretation
ideas.summary: Keep OCR outputs and line/contour outputs in separate layers so OCR cleanup cannot erase geometric evidence and line extraction cannot silently reinterpret dimension text.
ideas.next_check: Compare extracted OCR boxes and line candidates against a raster-sketch fixture with known scale and dimensions.

ideas.name: Orthographic reconstruction comparison fixture
ideas.summary: Build a benchmark of simple prismatic, revolved and assembled parts with front/top/side views, dimensions, raster degradation and known CAD sources; compare rule-based, learned and human-assisted routes.
ideas.next_check: Check research repositories and dataset licences for redistributable fixtures and whether output preserves editable CAD feature history.

ideas.name: Representation-aware backend selection
ideas.summary: Route each job using required outputs: OCS for the established session workflow, FreeCAD for constrained feature history, code-CAD for reproducible exact B-rep source, and Blender/OpenSCAD for mesh or scene routes; record when a format conversion changes representation.
ideas.next_check: Run a controlled exact solid and mesh fixture through each installed backend and record representation and history outcomes.

ideas.name: Dimension and hidden-surface ambiguity queue
ideas.summary: Keep inferred values, obscured surfaces, uncertain symbols and competing projection correspondences in a small question queue; proceed only on independent geometry that does not depend on those items.
ideas.next_check: Design test cases where two distinct solids satisfy the same incomplete views and verify that the workflow reports both candidates.

representation_notes: Inputs within inputs[] are all required. For operations with input_alternatives, every input[] item is required AND exactly one alternative group must be satisfied; each alternative group is itself an AND set. Outputs list only types guaranteed for every accepted input branch.
Additional type: verification-report is a saved set of check results, failed operation IDs, affected artifact IDs and artifact revision/hash; it is used to diagnose/recover a failed transition.

CAD-10 outputs an internal/kernel cad-solid; exact-format export is a separate handoff and OCS STEP is faceted in the inspected checkout. CAD-15 outputs mesh from OpenSCAD source. Mesh and cad-solid remain separate representation types.

Additional types: native-model-document is the editable saved model in its owning CAD application; it preserves available application features/history but does not imply a common editable feature tree across applications. CAD-16 makes the photo-set → camera-solution/point-cloud/mesh transition explicit before CAD-11 fitting.
native-model-document is an additional representation type: a saved editable document in its owning CAD application; available feature history depends on that application.
